evidence.reason: The finding asserts each switch only verifies the final runtime and never ties both journal completion entries to new fixture-log entries. Current code does exactly that: switch_phase passes the pre-switch snapshot and current log to validate_completed (lines 941-942), and that function requires exactly two distinct invocations absent from the baseline (909-911), each evidence item unit/runtime/success-bound (912-914), and every item present in the completion log via completion_logged (915-916). Thus each of the two journaled completions is matched to a new log entry, not just the last runtime. The history contains the targeted fix commit b1cdf7abc 'Match both journal completions against the fixture log' (also 7ce75ead, which routes switch-back through validate_completed), superseding the alleged weakness. The residual records_after[-1] check at 949-952 is redundant belt-and-suspenders, not the only validation.
